accounting_period_close_state.name: accounting_period_close_state
accounting_period_close_state.value:
("accounting_periods"."status" = 'open' and "accounting_periods"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("accounting_periods"."status" = 'soft_closed' and "accounting_periods"."soft_closed_at" is not null and "accounting_periods"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("accounting_periods"."status" = 'closed' and "accounting_periods"."closed_at" is not null)

audit_event_entity_identity.name: audit_event_entity_identity
audit_event_entity_identity.value: "audit_events"."entity_id" is not null or "audit_events"."entity_external_id" is not null

audit_event_actor_identity.name: audit_event_actor_identity
audit_event_actor_identity.value:
("audit_events"."actor_type" <> 'staff' or "audit_events"."actor_staff_member_id" is not null)
        and ("audit_events"."actor_type" = 'staff' or "audit_events"."actor_staff_member_id" is null)

location_dates_ordered.name: location_dates_ordered
location_dates_ordered.value: "locations"."closed_on" is null or "locations"."opened_on" is null or "locations"."closed_on" >= "locations"."opened_on"

staff_dates_ordered.name: staff_dates_ordered
staff_dates_ordered.value: "staff_members"."terminated_on" is null or "staff_members"."hired_on" is null or "staff_members"."terminated_on" >= "staff_members"."hired_on"

extraction_run_times_ordered.name: extraction_run_times_ordered
extraction_run_times_ordered.value: "extraction_runs"."finished_at" is null or "extraction_runs"."started_at" is null or "extraction_runs"."finished_at" >= "extraction_runs"."started_at"

integration_event_times_ordered.name: integration_event_times_ordered
integration_event_times_ordered.value:
"integration_events"."processed_at" is null
        or "integration_events"."processing_started_at" is null
        or "integration_events"."processed_at" >= "integration_events"."processing_started_at"

inventory_count_line_variance.name: inventory_count_line_variance
inventory_count_line_variance.value:
(
          "inventory_count_lines"."expected_quantity" is not null
          and "inventory_count_lines"."counted_quantity" is not null
          and "inventory_count_lines"."variance_quantity" = "inventory_count_lines"."counted_quantity" - "inventory_count_lines"."expected_quantity"
        )
        or (
          ("inventory_count_lines"."expected_quantity" is null or "inventory_count_lines"."counted_quantity" is null)
          and "inventory_count_lines"."variance_quantity" is null
        )

inventory_count_line_counted_timestamp.name: inventory_count_line_counted_timestamp
inventory_count_line_counted_timestamp.value: "inventory_count_lines"."counted_quantity" is null or "inventory_count_lines"."counted_at" is not null

inventory_count_source_external_uidx.name: inventory_count_source_external_uidx
inventory_count_source_external_uidx.where: "inventory_count_sessions"."source_system" is not null and "inventory_count_sessions"."external_id" is not null

inventory_count_times_ordered.name: inventory_count_times_ordered
inventory_count_times_ordered.value:
("inventory_count_sessions"."started_at" is null or "inventory_count_sessions"."started_at" <= "inventory_count_sessions"."as_of")
        and ("inventory_count_sessions"."submitted_at" is null or "inventory_count_sessions"."started_at" is null or "inventory_count_sessions"."submitted_at" >= "inventory_count_sessions"."started_at")
        and ("inventory_count_sessions"."posted_at" is null or "inventory_count_sessions"."submitted_at" is null or "inventory_count_sessions"."posted_at" >= "inventory_count_sessions"."submitted_at")

inventory_count_submission_state.name: inventory_count_submission_state
inventory_count_submission_state.value: "inventory_count_sessions"."status" not in ('submitted', 'posted') or "inventory_count_sessions"."submitted_at" is not null

inventory_movement_source_external_uidx.name: inventory_movement_source_external_uidx
inventory_movement_source_external_uidx.where: "inventory_movements"."source_system" is not null and "inventory_movements"."external_id" is not null

inventory_movement_transfer_group.name: inventory_movement_transfer_group
inventory_movement_transfer_group.value: "inventory_movements"."movement_type" not in ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out') or "inventory_movements"."movement_group_id" is not null

inventory_movement_sale_source.name: inventory_movement_sale_source
inventory_movement_sale_source.value: "inventory_movements"."movement_type" not in ('sale', 'sale_return') or "inventory_movements"."sales_order_line_id" is not null

inventory_movement_recipe_source.name: inventory_movement_recipe_source
inventory_movement_recipe_source.value: "inventory_movements"."movement_type" not in ('recipe_consumption', 'recipe_production') or "inventory_movements"."recipe_version_id" is not null

journal_batch_source_external_uidx.name: journal_batch_source_external_uidx
journal_batch_source_external_uidx.where: "journal_batches"."source_system" is not null and "journal_batches"."external_id" is not null

journal_line_foreign_values.name: journal_line_foreign_values
journal_line_foreign_values.value:
(
          "journal_lines"."foreign_currency" is null
          and "journal_lines"."foreign_amount_cents" is null
          and "journal_lines"."exchange_rate" is null
        )
        or (
          "journal_lines"."foreign_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
          and "journal_lines"."foreign_amount_cents" is not null
          and "journal_lines"."exchange_rate" > 0
        )

goods_receipt_source_external_uidx.name: goods_receipt_source_external_uidx
goods_receipt_source_external_uidx.where: "goods_receipts"."source_system" is not null and "goods_receipts"."external_id" is not null

goods_receipt_posting_state.name: goods_receipt_posting_state
goods_receipt_posting_state.value: "goods_receipts"."status" not in ('posted', 'reversed') or "goods_receipts"."posted_at" is not null

purchase_line_item_fields.name: purchase_line_item_fields
purchase_line_item_fields.value: "purchase_lines"."line_type" <> 'item' or ("purchase_lines"."product_id" is not null and "purchase_lines"."quantity" is not null and "purchase_lines"."uom_id" is not null and "purchase_lines"."unit_cost_cents" is not null)

purchase_source_external_uidx.name: purchase_source_external_uidx
purchase_source_external_uidx.where: "purchases"."source_system" is not null and "purchases"."external_id" is not null

purchase_posting_state.name: purchase_posting_state
purchase_posting_state.value: "purchases"."status" not in ('posted', 'reversed') or "purchases"."posted_at" is not null

purchase_distinct_revision_links.name: purchase_distinct_revision_links
purchase_distinct_revision_links.value: "purchases"."reversal_of_purchase_id" is null or "purchases"."supersedes_purchase_id" is null or "purchases"."reversal_of_purchase_id" <> "purchases"."supersedes_purchase_id"

recipe_component_target.name: recipe_component_target
recipe_component_target.value:
(
          "recipe_components"."component_type" = 'product'
          and "recipe_components"."product_id" is not null
          and "recipe_components"."nested_recipe_version_id" is null
        )
        or (
          "recipe_components"."component_type" = 'recipe'
          and "recipe_components"."product_id" is null
          and "recipe_components"."nested_recipe_version_id" is not null
        )

recipe_source_external_uidx.name: recipe_source_external_uidx
recipe_source_external_uidx.where: "recipes"."source_system" is not null and "recipes"."external_id" is not null

settlement_period_dates_ordered.name: settlement_period_dates_ordered
settlement_period_dates_ordered.value: "settlements"."period_ends_on" is null or "settlements"."period_starts_on" is null or "settlements"."period_ends_on" >= "settlements"."period_starts_on"

settlement_paid_state.name: settlement_paid_state
settlement_paid_state.value: "settlements"."status" not in ('paid', 'reversed') or "settlements"."paid_at" is not null
